scope: Targeted dynamic-row and deep-nesting validation; the 45-case overview was not rerun.

productionHashes.algorithm: sha256 over sorted JS paths plus file bytes

methodology.browser: Production packages built into the same Playwright fixture. Real Edge module Worker, 20ms scheduler delay, react-dom/profiling. Three warmups then fifteen measured textarea edits per scenario; version order alternates by scenario. Median/P95 are descriptive for fifteen samples. Input-to-preview ends at two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after commit, not completed paint. JSON UTF-8 lengths estimate messages, not structured-clone bytes. Before and after are measured sequentially on one machine and are not statistically controlled.
node: Production bundle, in-process Worker handler: no browser rendering, scheduling delay or thread message latency.
Every response crosses structuredClone before application. UTF-8 JSON bytes estimate payload size, not structured-clone size.
P95 is exploratory with 15 measured edits. Each case has one persistent compiler session.
methodology.depth: Serial isolated processes. Public production compileLocal. First compile after import reported separately; 2 further warmups and 10 measured calls by default, with per-case/CLI overrides recorded on each result. --once stops after the first compile; --soak replaces timing loops with successive edit versions and GC checkpoints every 10 versions. No forced GC inside ordinary timing loops. Input generation, assertions and optional one-shot structuredClone excluded from compile timing. GC snapshots before/after first compile, with result retained and released. Peak RSS is OS process.resourceUsage maxRSS (KiB converted to bytes), includes runtime/import/input and is captured before correctness traversal or cloning on first compile. Returned node count excludes intermediate allocations. P95 for small sample counts is descriptive only. Uncaught errors, process exits and timeout are separate outcomes. Results written after every case.
methodology.memory: Isolated production-package processes with explicit GC before every memory snapshot. Long edits retain the previous preview until its replacement exists. RSS peak covers the entire child; heapUsed is a post-GC snapshot, not total allocations. No hard real-time or cross-machine memory threshold is inferred.
methodology.timingNotes: Browser before samples are retained from the first paired run, after samples were rerun on the final build. Both runs use three warmups and fifteen measurements. Node multi-case and isolated-shift runs are separate batches; all are retained, including regressions. Deep browser timings are functional-verification samples, not medians.

deepBrowser.methodology: Production ESM, real module Worker and public scheduler with author analysis. 100/500/1000 quote levels, deep edits, 1001 budget rejection, ordinary recovery, 1000 nested lists and 500 quote/list pairs; repeat with one forged cyclic flat response. CM6 and React preview verified 500/1000 quote levels, 1000 unordered/ordered lists and mixed containers, parameter retention and recomputed interpolation. Timings are verification samples, not benchmark percentiles.
